title: Skill graph file
description: A sport's skill graph: a list of skill nodes. A node unlocks once every node in its prerequisites is mastered.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique within the sport.

category.description: Skill category, e.g. shooting, dribbling, layups, finishes, moves, iq, defending.

prerequisites.description: Ids of nodes that must ALL be mastered before this node unlocks. Empty means a starting node.

practice.description: What to practise before taking the skill test.

video_long.description: Full YouTube video, for users with more time. Null until chosen.

video_short.description: Short reels-style clip, for users with less time. Null until chosen.

type.description: vision: model checks form in the user's video. tally: model counts reps or makes. self_check: user confirms it themselves.

criteria.description: What counts as passing the skill test.

analyzer.description: Path to the analyzer spec in /vision (e.g. vision/analyzers/shot-form.md). Null for self_check.
